_note: Hand-verified REAL national resources (not simulated) for categories with no public place-locator API — food, clothing, transportation, community_support. These are nationwide referrals (hotlines / locators), so they carry no coordinates: they appear in every search for their category as a national option, and do not place a map pin. Each was verified against the org's official site. Update by editing this file and re-running: node --experimental-strip-types ingestion/run.ts --source curated-national

resources.name: USDA National Hunger Hotline
resources.description: Call the USDA National Hunger Hotline to find food pantries, meal sites, and food assistance near you (Mon–Fri, 8am–8pm ET). En español: 1-877-842-6273. Or text FOOD to 914-342-7744.
resources.eligibility: Open to anyone in the U.S. looking for food help. Free.

resources.name: Feeding America — Find Your Local Food Bank
resources.description: Enter your ZIP to find your nearest food bank and free grocery distributions through Feeding America's national network of 200+ food banks.
resources.eligibility: Anyone in need of food. Requirements vary by local food bank.

resources.name: 211 — Local Food Assistance
resources.description: Dial 211 to connect with local food pantries, meal programs, and emergency food near you — free and confidential, available 24/7.
resources.eligibility: Open to everyone. Free and confidential.

resources.name: SNAP (Food Stamps)
resources.description: SNAP helps pay for groceries each month. You apply through your state — check whether you qualify and find your state's application.
resources.eligibility: Based on household income and size. Many veterans qualify — apply through your state.

resources.name: 211 — Clothing & Essentials
resources.description: Dial 211 to find local clothing closets and free essential-item assistance (coats, work clothes, household basics) near you.
resources.eligibility: Open to everyone. Free and confidential.

resources.name: The Salvation Army
resources.description: The Salvation Army provides free or low-cost clothing and household essentials at local centers nationwide, plus vouchers through many family stores.
resources.eligibility: Assistance for individuals and families in need. Ask your local center.

resources.name: Goodwill — Find a Local Center
resources.description: Find a nearby Goodwill for low-cost clothing and, at many locations, free interview-ready clothing tied to their job programs.
resources.eligibility: Open to everyone; job-program clothing help varies by location.

resources.name: VA Veterans Transportation Service (VTS)
resources.description: The VA's Veterans Transportation Service offers free rides to and from VA medical appointments. Call 1-800-MyVA411 or ask your VA facility's transportation office.
resources.eligibility: Veterans enrolled in VA health care with a VA-authorized appointment. Availability varies by facility.

resources.name: DAV — Free Rides to VA Appointments
resources.description: Disabled American Veterans runs volunteer drivers who give free rides to and from VA medical appointments at VA locations across the country.
resources.eligibility: Veterans needing a ride to VA medical care. Contact your local DAV Hospital Service Coordinator.

resources.name: 211 — Transportation Help
resources.description: Dial 211 to find local transportation help — rides to appointments, transit passes, and non-emergency medical transport near you.
resources.eligibility: Open to everyone. Free and confidential.

resources.name: VA Caregiver Support Line
resources.description: Free support for family caregivers of veterans — the Caregiver Support Line connects you with resources and your local support coordinator.

resources.name: Vet Centers — Call 1-877-WAR-VETS
resources.description: Vet Centers offer free, confidential counseling and community for combat veterans and their families. Call 1-877-927-8387 anytime, day or night.
resources.eligibility: Combat veterans, service members, and their families. No VA enrollment needed.

resources.name: 211 — Community & Social Services
resources.description: Dial 211 for local community support — peer groups, caregiver help, and social services near you, free and confidential, 24/7.
resources.eligibility: Open to everyone. Free and confidential.
